verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Yas'aloonaka anil-anfaal qulil-anfaali Lillaahi war-rasooli fattaqoo Allaaha wa aslihoo dhaata baynikum wa atee'oo Allaaha wa rasoolahu in kuntum mu'mineen
Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena idhaa dhukira Allaahu wajilat quloobuhum wa idhaa tuliyat alayhim aayaatuhu zaadathum eemaanan wa alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
Al-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Ulaa'ika humul-mu'minoona haqqan lahum darajaatun inda rabbihim wa maghfiratun wa rizqun kareem
Kamaa akhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bil-haqqi wa inna fareeqan minal-mu'mineena lakaarihoon
Yujaadiloonaka fil-haqqi ba'damaa tabayyana ka'annamaa yusaaqoona ilal-mawti wa hum yanzuroon
Wa idh ya'idukumu Allaahu ihdat-taa'ifatayni annahaa lakum wa tawaddoona anna ghayra dhaatish-shawkati takoonu lakum wa yureedu Allaahu an yuhiqqal-haqqa bikalimaatihi wa yaqta'a daabiral-kaafireen
Liyuhiqqal-haqqa wa yubtilal-baatila wa law karihal-mujrimoon
Idh tastagheethoona rabbakum fastajaaba lakum annee mumiddukum bi-alfin minal-malaa'ikati murdifeen
Wa maa ja'alahu Allaahu illaa bushraa wa litatma'inna bihi quloobukum wa man-nasru illaa min indi Allaahi innallaaha azeezun hakeem
Idh yughashsheekumun-nu'aasa amanatan minhu wa yunazzilu alaykum minas-samaa'i maa'an liyutahhirakum bihi wa yudhhiba ankum rijzash-shaytaani wa liyarbita alaa quloobikum wa yuthabbita bihil-aqdaam
Idh yoohee rabbuka ilal-malaa'ikati annee ma'akum fathabbitul-ladheena aamanoo sa'ulqee fee quloobil-ladheena kafarur-ru'ba fadriboo fawqal-a'naaqi wadriboo minhum kulla banaan
Dhaalika bi-annahum shaaqqoo Allaaha wa rasoolahu wa man yushaaqiqi Allaaha wa rasoolahu fa-innallaaha shadeedul-iqaab
Dhaalikum fadhooqoohu wa anna lilkaafireena adhaaban-naar
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa laqeetumul-ladheena kafaroo zahfan falaa tuwalloohumul-adbaar
Wa man yuwallihim yawma'idhin duburahu illaa mutaharrifan liqitaalin aw mutahayyizan ilaa fi'atin faqad baa'a bighadabin mina Allaahi wa ma'waahu jahannamu wa bi'sal-maseer
Falam taqtuloohum wa laakinna Allaaha qatalahum wa maa ramayta idh ramayta wa laakinna Allaaha ramaa wa liyubliyal-mu'mineena minhu balaa'an hasanan innallaaha samee'un aleem
Dhaalikum wa annallaaha moohinu kaydil-kaafireen
In tastaftihoo faqad jaa'akumul-fathu wa in tantahoo fahuwa khayrun lakum wa in ta'oodoo na'ud wa lan tughniya ankum fi'atukum shay'an wa law kathurat wa annallaaha ma'al-mu'mineen
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo atee'oo Allaaha wa rasoolahu wa laa tawallaw anhu wa antum tasma'oon
Wa laa takoonoo kal-ladheena qaaloo sami'naa wa hum laa yasma'oon
Inna sharrad-dawaabbi indallaahis-summul-bukmul-ladheena laa ya'qiloon
Wa law alima Allaahu feehim khayran la-asma'ahum wa law asma'ahum latawallaw wa hum mu'ridoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo istajeeboo Lillaahi wa lir-rasooli idhaa da'aakum limaa yuhyeekum wa'lamoo annallaaha yahoolu baynal-mar'i wa qalbihi wa annahu ilayhi tuhsharoon
Wattaqoo fitnatan laa tuseebannal-ladheena zalamoo minkum khaassatan wa'lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-iqaab
Wadhkuroo idh antum qaleelun mustad'afoona fil-ardi takhaafoona an yatakhattafakumun-naasu fa-aawaakum wa ayyadakum binasrihi wa razaqakum minat-tayyibaati la-allakum tashkuroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takhoonoo Allaaha war-rasoola wa takhoonoo amaanaatikum wa antum ta'lamoon
Wa'lamoo annamaa amwaalukum wa awlaadukum fitnatun wa annallaaha indahu ajrun azeem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tattaqoo Allaaha yaj'al lakum furqaanan wa yukaffir ankum sayyi'aatikum wa yaghfir lakum Wallaahu dhul-fadlil-azeem
Wa idh yamkuru bikal-ladheena kafaroo liyuthbitooka aw yaqtulooka aw yukhrijooka wa yamkuroona wa yamkuru Allaahu Wallaahu khayrul-maakireen
Wa idhaa tutlaa alayhim aayaatunaa qaaloo qad sami'naa law nashaa'u laqulnaa mithla haadhaa in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
Wa idh qaaloo Allaahumma in kaana haadhaa huwal-haqqa min indika fa-amtir alaynaa hijaaratan minas-samaa'i aw i'tinaa bi-adhaabin aleem
Wa maa kaana Allaahu liyu'adhdhibahum wa anta feehim wa maa kaana Allaahu mu'adhdhibahum wa hum yastaghfiroon
Wa maa lahum allaa yu'adhdhibahumu Allaahu wa hum yasuddoona anil-masjidil-haraami wa maa kaanoo awliyaa'ahu in awliyaa'uuhu illal-muttaqoona wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wa maa kaana salaatuhum indal-bayti illaa mukaa'an wa tasdiyatan fadhooqul-adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Innal-ladheena kafaroo yunfiqoona amwaalahum liyasuddoo an sabeelillaahi fasayunfiqoonahaa thumma takoonu alayhim hasratan thumma yughlaboona wal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa jahannama yuhsharoon
Liyameeza Allaahul-khabeetha minat-tayyibi wa yaj'alal-khabeetha ba'dahu alaa ba'din fayarkumahu jamee'an fayaj'alahu fee jahannama ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Qul lilladheena kafaroo in yantahoo yughfar lahum maa qad salafa wa in ya'oodoo faqad madat sunnatul-awwaleen
Wa qaatiloohum hattaa laa takoona fitnatun wa yakoonad-deenu kulluhu Lillaahi fa-ini intahaw fa-innallaaha bimaa ya'maloona baseer
Wa in tawallaw fa'lamoo annallaaha mawlaakum ni'mal-mawlaa wa ni'man-naseer

Wa'lamoo annamaa ghanimtum min shay'in fa-anna Lillaahi khumusahu wa lir-rasooli wa lidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli in kuntum aamantum Billaahi wa maa anzalnaa alaa abdinaa yawmal-furqaani yawma iltaqal-jam'aani Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

Idh antum bil-udwatid-dunyaa wa hum bil-udwatil-quswaa war-rakbu asfala minkum wa law tawaa'adttum laakhtalaftum fil-mee'aadi wa laakin liyaqdiya Allaahu amran kaana maf'oolan liyahlika man halaka an bayyinatin wa yahyaa man hayya an bayyinatin wa innallaaha lasamee'un aleem
Idh yureekahumu Allaahu fee manaamika qaleelan wa law araakahum katheeran lafashiltum wa latanaaza'tum fil-amri wa laakinna Allaaha sallama innahu aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Wa idh yureekumoohum idhil-taqaytum fee a'yunikum qaleelan wa yuqallilukum fee a'yunihim liyaqdiya Allaahu amran kaana maf'oolan wa ilaa Allaahi turja'ul-umoor
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa laqeetum fi'atan fathbutoo wadhkuroo Allaaha katheeran la-allakum tuflihoon
Wa atee'oo Allaaha wa rasoolahu wa laa tanaaza'oo fatafshaloo wa tadhhaba reehukum wasbiroo innallaaha ma'as-saabireen
Wa laa takoonoo kal-ladheena kharajoo min diyaarihim bataran wa ri'aa'an-naasi wa yasuddoona an sabeelillaahi Wallaahu bimaa ya'maloona muheet

Wa idh zayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum wa qaala laa ghaaliba lakumul-yawma minan-naasi wa innee jaarun lakum falammaa taraa'atil-fi'ataani nakasa alaa aqibayhi wa qaala innee baree'un minkum innee araa maa laa tarawna inniyi akhaafu Allaaha Wallaahu shadeedul-iqaab
Idh yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun gharra haa'ulaa'i deenuhum wa man yatawakkal alaa Allaahi fa-innallaaha azeezun hakeem
Wa law taraa idh yatawaffal-ladheena kafarul-malaa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum wa adbaarahum wa dhooqoo adhaabal-hareeq
Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat aydeekum wa annallaaha laysa bizallaamin lil-abeed
Kada'bi aali fir'awna wal-ladheena min qablihim kafaroo bi-aayaati Allaahi fa-akhadhahumu Allaahu bidhunoobihim innallaaha qawiyyun shadeedul-iqaab
Dhaalika bi-anna Allaaha lam yaku mughayyiran ni'matan an'amahaa alaa qawmin hattaa yughayyiroo maa bi-anfusihim wa annallaaha samee'un aleem
Kada'bi aali fir'awna wal-ladheena min qablihim kadhdhaboo bi-aayaati rabbihim fa-ahlaknaahum bidhunoobihim wa aghraqnaa aala fir'awna wa kullun kaanoo zaalimeen
Inna sharrad-dawaabbi indallaahil-ladheena kafaroo fahum laa yu'minoon
Al-ladheena aahadta minhum thumma yanqudoona ahdahum fee kulli marratin wa hum laa yattaqoon
Fa-immaa tathqafannahum fil-harbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum la-allahum yadhdhakkaroon
Wa immaa takhaafanna min qawmin khiyaanatan fanbidh ilayhim alaa sawaa'in innallaaha laa yuhibbul-khaa'ineen
Wa laa yahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo sabaqoo innahum laa yu'jizoon

Wa a'iddoo lahum mas-tata'tum min quwwatin wa min ribaatil-khayli turhiboona bihi aduwwa Allaahi wa aduwwakum wa aakhareena min doonihim laa ta'lamoonahumu Allaahu ya'lamuhum wa maa tunfiqoo min shay'in fee sabeelillaahi yuwaffa ilaykum wa antum laa tuzlamoon
Wa in janahoo lis-salmi fajnah lahaa wa tawakkal alaa Allaahi innahu huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Wa in yureedoo an yakhda'ooka fa-inna hasbaka Allaahu huwal-ladhee ayyadaka binasrihi wa bil-mu'mineen
Wa allafa bayna quloobihim law anfaqta maa fil-ardi jamee'an maa allafta bayna quloobihim wa laakinna Allaaha allafa baynahum innahu azeezun hakeem
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu hasbuka Allaahu wa manit-taba'aka minal-mu'mineen

Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu harridil-mu'mineena alal-qitaali in yakun minkum ishroona saabiroona yaghliboo miaa'atayni wa in yakun minkum miaa'atun yaghliboo alfan minal-ladheena kafaroo bi-annahum qawmun laa yafqahoon

Al-aana khaffafa Allaahu ankum wa alima anna feekum da'fan fa-in yakun minkum miaa'atun saabiratun yaghliboo miaa'atayni wa in yakun minkum alfun yaghliboo alfayni bi-idhni Allaahi Wallaahu ma'as-saabireen
Maa kaana linabiyyin an yakoona lahu asraa hattaa yuthkhina fil-ardi tureedoona aradad-dunyaa Wallaahu yureedul-aakhirata Wallaahu azeezun hakeem
Lawlaa kitaabun mina Allaahi sabaqa lamassakum feemaa akhadhtum adhaabun azeem
Fakuloo mimmaa ghanimtum halaalan tayyiban wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul liman fee aydeekum minal-asraa in ya'lami Allaahu fee quloobikum khayran yu'tikum khayran mimmaa ukhidha minkum wa yaghfir lakum Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Wa in yureedoo khiyaanataka faqad khaanoo Allaaha min qablu fa-amkana minhum Wallaahu aleemun hakeem

Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa haajaroo wa jaahadoo bi-amwaalihim wa anfusihim fee sabeelillaahi wal-ladheena aawaw wa nasaroo ulaa'ika ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'din wal-ladheena aamanoo wa lam yuhaajaroo maa lakum min walaayatihim min shay'in hattaa yuhaajiroo wa inis-tansarookum fid-deeni fa-alaykumun-nasru illaa alaa qawmin baynakum wa baynahum meethaaqun Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
Wal-ladheena kafaroo ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'din illaa taf'aloohu takun fitnatun fil-ardi wa fasaadun kabeer
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa haajaroo wa jaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi wal-ladheena aawaw wa nasaroo ulaa'ika humul-mu'minoona haqqan lahum maghfiratun wa rizqun kareem
Wal-ladheena aamanoo min ba'du wa haajaroo wa jaahadoo ma'akum fa-ulaa'ika minkum wa ulul-arhaami ba'duhum awlaa biba'din fee kitaabillaahi innallaaha bikulli shay'in aleem
